chunks.embeddingText: Table ApprovePO. Domain: Purchase order (PO) approval. Purpose: tracks each approver assignment on a purchase order for the standard (non-HOD) approval queue used by the PO approval portal. Columns: PoNo (PO number), ApprovalName (approver username), status (Pending, Approved, Approved by user, Rejected), PODate, ApprovalDate, TransId (unique row id). Joins: ApprovePO.PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode = Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode; ApprovalName = POAllocation.username. Synonyms: pending PO, purchase order approval, PO waiting, standard PO queue. Filter pending with status = 'Pending'. For approved counts use status LIKE 'Approved%'.

Table ApprovePOHOD. Domain: Purchase order HOD approval. Purpose: HOD authority purchase order approval assignments; portal unions this with ApprovePO for pending POs. Columns: PoNo, ApprovalName, status (Pending/Approved/Rejected), PODate, ApprovalDate, transid. Joins: PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode = Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode. Synonyms: HOD PO approval, head of department PO pending, ApprovePOHOD. Pending filter: status = 'Pending'.

Table ApproveWorkOrder. Domain: Work order (WO) approval. Purpose: approval assignments for work orders; PoNo is the work order code. Columns: PoNo, ApprovalName, status (Pending/Approved by user/Rejected), PODate, ApprovalDate, Transid. Joins: ApproveWorkOrder.PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode for TotalAmount and CompanyName. Synonyms: pending work order, WO approval, job work order. Pending filter: status = 'Pending'.

Table ApproveIndent. Domain: Indent / purchase requisition approval. Purpose: approver assignments on indents. Columns: IndentNo (parent indent), IndentSubCode (line code), ApprovalName, Status (Pending/Approved/Rejected), IndentDate, ApprovalDate, transId. Critical joins: IndentSubCode = ItemInfo.code; IndentNo = Vw_StoreDeptt.Expr1. Do not join ItemInfo.code to IndentNo. Synonyms: pending indent, purchase requisition, store indent approval. Pending filter: Status = 'Pending'.

Table PurchasePayment. Domain: PO and work-order header commercial data. Purpose: TotalAmount, CompanyName, Currency, delivery and payment terms for a PurchaseCode. Not bill/vendor payment requests (those are BillPayment*). Columns include PurchaseCode (PK), TotalAmount, CompanyName, Currency, LoginName, TypeOfPO, DepttName, deliverydate, Payment terms text, PoSignal, taxes/discounts. Joins: PurchaseCode = ApprovePO.PoNo / ApproveWorkOrder.PoNo / Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode / FinalQuotation.PurchaseCode. Synonyms: PO amount, PO header total, purchase order value.

View Vw_PurchaseOrder. Domain: Purchase order line and vendor details. Purpose: display PO items, FirmName vendor, qty, rate, GST; used by portal PO details. Key columns: PurchaseCode, FirmName, ItemDesc, ItemCode, Qty, Rate, Total, PendingQty, DepttName, CompanyName, Currency, deliverydate, VendorCode, hsncode, tax fields. Join: PurchaseCode = ApprovePO.PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode. Synonyms: PO details, PO line items, vendor name on PO. Not for approval status — use ApprovePO.

Table FinalQuotation. Domain: PO / Quotation. Purpose: final selected vendor quote lines for a PurchaseCode (FirmName, ItemCode, Qty, Rate, Total, GST). Join PurchaseCode to PurchasePayment, Vw_PurchaseOrder, and Vw_Quotation.PurchaseCode. Synonyms: final quotation, awarded quote, PO quote lines. For comparing multiple vendor quotes before finalization prefer Vw_Quotation. Always TOP 50.

Table POAllocation. Domain: PO approval authority mapping. Purpose: username to CompanyName, Deptt, authority level, POAmount/ItemAmount/PartyAmount limits. Columns: username, CompanyName, POAmount, ItemAmount, PartyAmount, NewVendor, NewItem, Deptt, srno, authority. Join username to ApprovePO.ApprovalName / ApproveWorkOrder.ApprovalName. Synonyms: PO approver allocation, authority limits, who can approve. Table name may appear as poallocation in older SQL.

Table BillPaymentHODApproval. Domain: Bill payment approval. Purpose: pending/approved payment request assignments for approvers; main pending-payments table in the portal. Columns: paymentNo (join key), BillNo, MRNo, PartyName (vendor), PaymentAmount, PaymentDate, LoginName (requester), ApprovalName, Status (Pending/Approved/Rejected), ApprovalDate, Comment, transId. Join: paymentNo = BillPaymentEntry.PaymentNo. Synonyms: pending payment, bill payment approval, vendor payment request, PRQ. Pending filter: Status = 'Pending'.

Table BillPaymentEntry. Domain: Bill payment request details. Purpose: company, vendor, bill, MRN, amounts, bank, UTR, isPaid for a PaymentNo. Columns: PaymentNo, CompanyName, VendorName, BillNo, BillDate, MRNno (join to StoreInwardsPayment.MRNo / material receipt number), MRNDate, BillAmount, PaymentAmount, PaymentDate, status, UTRno, isPaid, IsCancel. PREFERRED for 'payment raised against MRN X / how much' => SELECT PaymentNo, MRNno, BillNo, PaymentAmount, BillAmount, status, isPaid FROM BillPaymentEntry WHERE MRNno = 'RM 269'. Join PaymentNo = BillPaymentHODApproval.paymentNo. Synonyms: payment details, bill payment entry, UTR, vendor bill, payment against material receipt. Pending approver queue is primarily BillPaymentHODApproval.

Table BillPaymentEntryApproval. Domain: Bill payment approval history. Purpose: historical approval rows with ApprovalName, ApprovalDate, comment, status for a PaymentNo; used by portal payment history API. Join PaymentNo to BillPaymentEntry and BillPaymentHODApproval.paymentNo. Synonyms: payment approval history, payment comments, who approved payment.

Table BillPaymentApprovalAllocation. Domain: Payment approver allocation. Purpose: ApprovalName mapped to CompanyName, Deptt, authority, ishod for bill payment routing. Join ApprovalName to BillPaymentHODApproval.ApprovalName. Synonyms: payment approver allocation, payment authority matrix.

Table ItemInfo. Domain: Indent line items. Purpose: itemcode, itemdesc, Qty, Unit, stock for indent lines. Critical: code equals ApproveIndent.IndentSubCode (line), not IndentNo (parent). For store issues join ItemInfo.itemcode = StoreOutwards.Itemcode (not code). For warehouse stock join ItemInfo.itemcode = WareHouse.ItemCode. Example IndentNo PIL/22-23/RWM00019 with IndentSubCode PIL/22-23/RWM00019/01. Synonyms: indent items, requisition lines, ItemInfo.

View Vw_StoreDeptt (also referenced as vw_storedeptt). Domain: Indent details. Purpose: portal indent detail lines. Expr1 = parent IndentNo; code = IndentSubCode line. Columns: Expr1, code, itemcode, itemdesc, Qty, Unit, Purpose, ReqDepartment, CompanyName, Deptt, IndentSignal, rates, BrandName. Join Expr1 to ApproveIndent.IndentNo; code to ItemInfo.code. Synonyms: indent details, indent items, store indent view.

Table FactoryInfo. Domain: Ledger / company master. Purpose: companies and factories for accounting and ledger summary. Columns: Name (company name), SrNo (company id), GroupName (group), Address, NewGSTNo (company GSTIN), GST (legacy), PermanentAccountNo (company PAN — NOT named PANNo; FactoryInfo has no PANNo column), LedgerOpeningDate, IndentCode, GroupTag. Join: FactoryInfo.Name = LedgerMaster.CompanyName. Synonyms: company list, factory list, unit master, company GST, company PAN, company group. For company GST/PAN questions select only from FactoryInfo using NewGSTNo and PermanentAccountNo.

Table LedgerMaster (also queried as ledgermaster). Domain: Ledger / chart of accounts. Purpose: party, vendor, bank and GL ledger master per CompanyName. Columns: CompanyName, LedgerName, Under (parent account/ledger GROUP — use DISTINCT Under for ledger groups; never empty LedgerGroupMaster), Openingbalance (opening balance — use for opening-balance questions), PendingBalance (pending/outstanding — use for pending balance questions; LedgerOpeningBalance table is EMPTY do not query it), Category, MainCategory, GSTNo, NewGSTNo, PANNo (ledger/party PAN only — company PAN is FactoryInfo.PermanentAccountNo), BankAccNo, BankName, IFSCCode, PaymentTerms, email, ContactNo, MSMENumber, LVendorCode, IsHold. Join CompanyName = FactoryInfo.Name. Synonyms: ledger list, party master, opening balance, pending balance, ledger outstanding, LedgerOpeningBalance (redirect here), ledger groups, account groups. For pending/opening bills/balances: SELECT LedgerName, Openingbalance, PendingBalance FROM LedgerMaster WHERE CompanyName = .... Do not use for full voucher/ledger statement SP. Avoid vw_LedgerSummary.

Table CommonLedgerMaster. Domain: Ledger. Purpose: common/shared ledger master similar to LedgerMaster with CompanyName, LedgerName, Under, balances, GST/PAN/bank, LSTATUS. Prefer LedgerMaster for normal portal ledger questions. Synonyms: common ledger master, shared chart of accounts.

Table StoreInwardsPayment. Domain: MRN / store inward header. Purpose: MRNo, SrNo, CompanyName (receiving company), PartyName/SupplierName (VENDOR only — e.g. Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase), BillNo, BillDate (NO MRDate column), BillAMount, ChallanNo, Gate_Inward_No, PONo, IndentNo. Join SrNo to StoreInwards; MRNo to BillPaymentEntry.MRNno. Synonyms: MRN, material receipt, store inward, GRN, goods receipt, find by bill number. Prefer Vw_StoreInwards for combined questions.

Table StoreInwards. Domain: MRN / store inward line items. Purpose: ItemCode, ItemName, RecdQty, AcceptedQty, OrderQty, PendingQty, Rate, Amount, PONo per SrNo. Join SrNo to StoreInwardsPayment for MRNo/party/bill. Large table — use TOP 50. Synonyms: MRN items, received materials, store inward lines.

View Vw_StoreInwards. Domain: MRN / store inward combined details. Preferred view for material receipt questions. Columns: SrNo, MRNo, PONo, CompanyName (receiving company), PartyName (VENDOR — e.g. Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase is a PartyName), BillNo, BillDate, GateInwardDate, SysDate, ItemName, ItemCode, RecdQty, AcceptedQty, OrderQty, PendingQty, Rate, Amount, Deptt, IndentNo, GateInwardNo, VendorGST, MRNStatus, LoginName. NO column MRDate — use BillDate/GateInwardDate/SysDate. Synonyms: goods receipt, GRN, material received, receipts by bill number. Example: Find receipts linked to bill number PPL/D/540 => WHERE BillNo = 'PPL/D/540' on THIS view (not BillPaymentEntry). Example: receipts for Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase => WHERE PartyName = '...'. Example: for company Oswal Extrusion Limited pending qty => CompanyName + PendingQty > 0. Always TOP 50.

View vw_MRNList. Domain: MRN listing. Purpose: list material receipts with CompanyName (receiving company), Partyname (vendor only), MRNDate (spelled MRNDate — never invent MRDate), MRno, BillNo, item quantities, GateInwardNo. Synonyms: MRN list, material receipt list, browse MRNs, recent goods receipts. For company filter use CompanyName; for vendor like Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase use Partyname. Use TOP 50. Column MRno is the MRN number.

View vw_MRNToBillPayment. Domain: MRN linked to bill payment. Purpose: connect material receipt MRno to PaymentNo, PaymentAmount, UTRno, BillNo, Partyname. CRITICAL: view is LINE grain — many rows have NULL PaymentNo even when payments exist for that MRN. For 'was payment raised against MRN RM 269 and for how much' prefer BillPaymentEntry WHERE MRNno = 'RM 269'. If using this view: SELECT DISTINCT PaymentNo, PaymentAmount WHERE MRno = 'RM 269' AND PaymentNo IS NOT NULL. Never treat a NULL PaymentNo row as proof of no payment. Synonyms: payment against MRN, was MRN paid, UTR for MRN, PRQ for material receipt. Bracket spaced columns: [Challan Date], [Basic Amount], [MRN User].

Table PurchaseReq. Domain: Purchase requisition (PR). Purpose: PR lines with Code (PR number like COMPANY/PR/yy-yy/...), CompanyName, Deptt, ItemCode, ItemDesc, Qty, Unit, Purpose, loginname, sysdate. Code is NOT IndentNo. Prefer Vw_PurchaseReq when comparing requested vs PO/received qty. Synonyms: purchase requisition, PR, purchase request. Always TOP 50.

View Vw_PurchaseReq. Domain: Purchase requisition (PR). Preferred view for PR questions. Columns: Code (PR number), ItemCode, ItemDesc, ReqQty, POQty, RecdQty, IndentQty, ChallanQty, PurchaseCode, CompanyName, Deptt, category, loginname, sysdate. Use WHERE CompanyName = 'Oswal Extrusion Limited' AND ReqQty > POQty for PRs not fully ordered. Synonyms: purchase requisition status, pending PR, PR vs PO. Large view — always TOP 50. Not for vendor quotations (use Vw_Quotation).

View Vw_Quotation. Domain: Vendor quotation. Preferred for quotation / quote comparison questions. Columns: PurchaseCode (joins PO), StoreCode (joins ApproveIndent.IndentNo), SubCode, FirmName (vendor), ItemCode, ItemDesc, Qty, Rate, NegoRate, Total, Discount, PaymentTerm, LoginName, Sysdate. Example: vendors quoting PO KPV/SPR/26-27/539 => WHERE PurchaseCode = 'KPV/SPR/26-27/539' SELECT FirmName, Rate, NegoRate, Total. NEVER use empty ApproveQuotation table. Prefer this over QuotationMaster. Always TOP 50 — large view (~667k rows).

View Vw_IndentQuotation. Domain: Quotation linked to indent. Columns: Storecode (IndentNo), SubCode (indent line / ItemInfo.code), ItemCode, itemdesc, Qty, IndentQty, Rate, NegoRate, Unit, IndentUnit, Discount. Use when question mixes indent and quotation quantities. Join Storecode = ApproveIndent.IndentNo. Prefer Vw_Quotation when asking by PurchaseCode/PO or vendor FirmName. Always TOP 50.

Table StoreOutwards. Domain: Store outward / material issue. Purpose: lines of material issued from store — IssueSlipNo, CompName (company, NOT CompanyName), Itemcode, ItemName, Qty, IssuedQty, Deptt, IssueTo, WareHouse, LoginName, sysDate. Large ~1.1M rows — always TOP 50. Join Itemcode = ItemInfo.itemcode (never ItemInfo.code). Synonyms: store issue, material issue, issue slip, issued to FIBC, stock issued, godown issue. Prefer vw_ItemInwardOutward for daily inward vs outward by item; vw_ItemMonthlyInwardOutward for monthly totals. Skip WarehouseStoreoutwards.

View vw_ItemInwardOutward. Domain: Store outward / inward summary. Preferred for daily InwardQty and Outwardqty by ItemCode, ItemName, companyname, Date. Company filter: companyname (not CompName, not CompanyName). Outward column spelling is Outwardqty. Example: Oswal Extrusion Limited WIP00013 outward 6988.50. Large view — always TOP 50. Synonyms: daily inward outward, how much issued, stock movement, item issue qty. For issue slip / Deptt / IssueTo use StoreOutwards. For monthly use vw_ItemMonthlyInwardOutward.

View vw_ItemMonthlyInwardOutward. Domain: Store outward monthly summary. Columns: MonthName, Month, Year, Itemcode, Itemname, InwardQty, OutwardQty, companyname. Filter Year=2026 AND Month=8 for August 2026. Prefer this for month totals; use vw_ItemInwardOutward for daily; StoreOutwards for issue slips. Always TOP 50.

Table WareHouse. Domain: Warehouse / stock. Purpose: current StkInHand per ItemCode, CompanyName, WareHouseName with Minlevel Maxlevel ReOrder. Company column CompanyName (not CompName). Join ItemCode = ItemInfo.itemcode. Below reorder: StkInHand < ReOrder AND ReOrder > 0. Example Oswal Extrusion Limited FIG00001 FIBC Bag Godown StkInHand ~2.1M; WIP00013 Liner Bag Godown 39476.4. Synonyms: stock in hand, godown stock, reorder level, current inventory. Prefer vw_itemwiseStock for simple lists. Always TOP 50. Not for material issue slips (use StoreOutwards).

View vw_itemwiseStock. Domain: Warehouse / stock. Preferred simple stock view: Warehousename, CompanyName, ItemCode, ItemName, StkInHand. Filter CompanyName = 'Oswal Extrusion Limited'. Synonyms: item wise stock, stock by godown, available stock, stock balance. For min/max/reorder use WareHouse. For group/dept use vw_inventoryitemwarehouse_all. Always TOP 50.

View vw_inventoryitemwarehouse_all. Domain: Warehouse / stock. Rich inventory: CompanyName, itemcode, ItemName, Deptt, GroupName, SubGroupName, StkInHand, unit, warehouse. Prefer when question mentions group or department. Simpler stock lists: vw_itemwiseStock. Reorder levels: WareHouse. Always TOP 50. Prefer this over smaller vw_inventoryitemwarehouse.

Table WareHouseMaster. Domain: Warehouse / stock. Purpose: master list of godowns — companyname, warehousename, Srno, entry/approval users. Examples: FIBC Bag Godown, Bobbin Godown, Raw Material Godown for Oswal Extrusion Limited. Does NOT hold StkInHand — use WareHouse or vw_itemwiseStock for quantities. Synonyms: list of warehouses, godown master, which warehouses.

Table DebitNote. Domain: Debit / credit notes. Purchase debit note headers — DebitNoteNumber (CO/DB/yy-yy/n), DebitType (Provisional, Qty Difference, Rate Difference), CompanyName (ours), PartyName (vendor), TotalDebitAmount, BillNo, MRNo, SrNo, Note, PurchaseLedger, sysdate. Prefer vw_DebitNote for combined header+sparse item columns. MRNo joins StoreInwardsPayment.MRNo. Do not rely on PONo=PurchasePayment. Synonyms: debit note, DN, vendor debit. Always TOP 50.

View vw_DebitNote. Domain: Debit / credit notes. Preferred debit note view — DebitNoteNumber, CompanyName, PartyName, DebitType, TotalDebitAmount, BillNo, MRNo, sysdate, optional ItemCode/ItemName (often blank). Prefer over DebitNote_store. Synonyms: debit note details, DN list. Always TOP 50.

Table CreditNote. Domain: Debit / credit notes. Sales credit note headers — CreditNoteNumber (CO/CR/yy-yy/n), CompanyName, PartyName (customer), TotalCreditAmount, CreditType, CreditNoteDate, invno, Note, SalesLedger, currency. Prefer vw_creditnote. Synonyms: credit note, CN, customer credit. Not purchase debit notes (use DebitNote). Always TOP 50.

View vw_creditnote. Domain: Debit / credit notes. Preferred credit note view — creditnotenumber, companyname, partyname, totalcreditamount, credittype, creditnotedate, invno, note, salesledger. Lowercase column names. Bracket [Company Address]. Synonyms: credit note details, CN list. Always TOP 50.

Table Vendor. Domain: Vendor masters. Purchase supplier master — FirmName, VendorCode (Ven#####), NewGSTNo, PANNo, Email, ContactName, Address City State, BankAccountNo BankName IFSCCode, PaymentTerms, ModeofPayment, ISMSME MSMENumber, TypeVendor Local/Import, IsClosed. Examples: Bright Rubber Ven00171 GST 24AACFB1249A1ZA; Chemline India Ltd Ven00191. Join FirmName/VendorCode to Vw_PurchaseOrder and Vw_Quotation. For vendor item rates use VendorRate or Vw_VendorItem (filter FirmName/ItemCode + TOP 50). For ledger pending balance use LedgerMaster not Vendor.Balance. Synonyms: vendor master, supplier GST, vendor bank, MSME vendor, IFSC. Always TOP 50.

View vw_VendorListwithBankdtls. Domain: Vendor masters. Compact list: FirmName, NewGSTNo, BankAccountNo, BankBranchName, IFSCCode, MSMENumber, PaymentTerms, ModeofPayment. Prefer for bank/IFSC questions. Full profile: Vendor table. Always TOP 50.

Table vendordata. Domain: Vendor masters. Snapshot with FirmName, LedgerName, GST PAN Email bank MSME. Prefer Vendor for full master/VendorCode. Use when mapping vendor to LedgerName for LedgerMaster balances. Always TOP 50.

Table InternalVendor. Domain: Vendor masters. Internal/group firm names (Plastene India Limited units etc.) with actualCompanyId. Not external suppliers — use Vendor for supplier GST/bank. Synonyms: internal vendor, group company as vendor.

Table VendorRate. Domain: Vendor rates. Detailed vendor-item rate history (~921k) — FirmName, ItemCode, SubCode, Rate, NegoRate, Qty, Unit, PaymentTerm, Discount, Sysdate, taxes. MUST WHERE FirmName or ItemCode and TOP 50. Example Bright Rubber recent UTI01107 Rate 2050; WIP00013 vendors include Gayatri Plastics. Prefer over Vw_VendorItem for PaymentTerm/taxes. For a specific PO/quotation use Vw_Quotation. Synonyms: vendor rate history, supplier rate, last rate, nego rate by vendor. Always TOP 50.

View Vw_VendorItem. Domain: Vendor rates. Slim ~14.5M view: ItemCode, FirmName, Rate, NegoRate, Qty, itemdesc, Sysdate. CRITICAL: always filter ItemCode or FirmName and TOP 50 — never unfiltered scan. Prefer VendorRate for detailed terms/taxes. Synonyms: vendors for item, vendor item rates, who supplies item. Always TOP 50.

View Vw_ReturnGatePass. Domain: Gate pass. Returnable gate pass (RGP) — GatePassNo (CO/yy-yy/GP/n), CompName (not CompanyName), ActualPartyName, PurposePartyName, ItemCode, ItemDesc, Qty, Purpose, Through, Rate. Pending returns: vw_returngatepasspending. Non-returnable uses Vw_NonReturnGatePass (NGP). Synonyms: returnable gate pass, RGP, return gate pass. Always TOP 50.

View Vw_NonReturnGatePass. Domain: Gate pass. Non-returnable gate pass (NRGP/NGP) — GatePassNo (CO/yy-yy/NGP/n), CompName, PartyName, ItemCode, ItemName, Qty, Purpose. Not returnable — for pending returns use vw_returngatepasspending / Vw_ReturnGatePass. Synonyms: non returnable gate pass, NRGP, NGP. Always TOP 50.

Table InwdReturnGatePass. Domain: Gate pass. Inward against RGP — InwGatePassNo (IGP), GatePassNo link to returnable pass, CompName, ItemCode, Qty. Synonyms: inward return gate pass, IGP, material returned. Pending open qty: vw_returngatepasspending. Always TOP 50.

View vw_returngatepasspending. Domain: Gate pass. Pending returnable quantities — GatePassNo, CompName, ItemCode, ReturnQty, InwardQty, PendingQty. Filter PendingQty > 0 for open returns (~546). Synonyms: pending gate pass return, open RGP, returnable pending. Always TOP 50.

View Vw_EditJOBWorkOrder. Domain: Job work. Formal job-work orders (~12 lines) — PurchaseCode (PIL/JRO or JWO), CompanyName, FirmName (job worker), ItemCode, ItemDesc, Qty, Rate, JobWorkCharges, GatePassNo, FPItemCode. Sparse legacy module — does not join PurchasePayment. For live material at job work use VW_JobWork_EBD_DTL; receipts VW_RECJOBWORK_EBD_DTL; returnable sends also Vw_ReturnGatePass Purpose Job Work. Synonyms: job work order, JWO, JRO, jobwork charges. Always TOP 50.

View VW_JobWork_EBD_DTL. Domain: Job work. Live item-level job-work MIS (~20k) — ItemCode, ItemName, companyname, Qty, GroupName, DescriptionGoods, MISCATEGORY, sysdate. Filter companyname/ItemCode + TOP 50. Prefer over VW_JobWork_EBD summary. Receipts from job work: VW_RECJOBWORK_EBD_DTL. Formal job-work orders: Vw_EditJOBWorkOrder. NOT for pending purchase work-order approval (use ApproveWorkOrder). Synonyms: material at job work, qty at job work, jobwork EBD. Always TOP 50.

View VW_RECJOBWORK_EBD_DTL. Domain: Job work. Receipts from job work (~17k) — CompanyName, ITEMCODE, ITEMNAME, MRNo (JBIN-SE...), Qty, GroupName, sysdate. Filter CompanyName/ITEMCODE + TOP 50. Sent/at job work: VW_JobWork_EBD_DTL. Formal job-work orders: Vw_EditJOBWorkOrder. NOT pending WO approval (ApproveWorkOrder). Synonyms: job work receipt, received from job work, JBIN. Always TOP 50.

View vw_Salesvoucher. Domain: Sales. Preferred sales invoice header — CompanyName, InvNo, InvDate, BuyerName (customer), BillAMount, InvType (Sales/Export Sales/InterUnit/Job Invoice), TypeofInvoice, currency, Destination, ShippingBillNo. Bracket spaced columns [Company Address] [Company GST]. Join items via SalesVoucherItem on CompanyName+InvNo. Compact list: vw_SalesInvList. Credit notes: CreditNote. Synonyms: sales invoice, tax invoice, buyer bill, export sales. Always TOP 50.

Table SalesVoucherItem. Domain: Sales. Invoice lines — CompanyName, InvNo, ITEMCODE, ItemName, ActualQty, Rate, Amount, HSNCODE, GST amounts. Join header vw_Salesvoucher on CompanyName+InvNo. Synonyms: sales invoice items, invoice lines. Always TOP 50.

View vw_SalesInvList. Domain: Sales. Compact invoice list — companyname, Invno (e.g. PPL/D/474), DespatchDate, BuyerName, OrgInvno. Prefer for recent lists; amounts on vw_Salesvoucher. Synonyms: invoice list, despatch invoices. Always TOP 50.

Table SalesVoucherTax. Domain: Sales. Tax lines on invoices — CompanyName, InvNo, TaxledgerName, Rate, Amount, PartyName, CreditNoteNumber. Join vw_Salesvoucher on CompanyName+InvNo. Synonyms: sales tax, invoice GST lines. Always TOP 50.

View VW_SALES_EBD_DTL. Domain: Sales. MIS sales qty (~138k) — companyname, InvNo, Commodity, qTY, itemcode, itemname. Prefer SalesVoucherItem for priced lines. Physical rolls/FIBC despatch: vw_MISrolldespatch / FIBCDespatch. Synonyms: sales EBD, despatch qty. Always TOP 50. NOT purchase/MRN.

View vw_MISrolldespatch. Domain: Despatch. Roll despatch (~1.16M) — RollNO, Quality, NetWt, Companyname, Partyname, Invno, sysdate, PONO. MUST filter company/inv/party/date + TOP 50. Prefer over MISRollforDespatch table. FIBC bails: FIBCDespatch. Yarn: MIS_YarnDespatch. Synonyms: roll despatch, rolls shipped. Always TOP 50.

Table FIBCDespatch. Domain: Despatch. FIBC/jumbo bail despatch (~1M) — CompanyName, PartyName, InvNo, BailNo, Qty, Wt, PACKINGLISTNO, vVehicleNo, ContainerNo, sysdate. MUST filter + TOP 50. Roll fabric despatch: vw_MISrolldespatch. Synonyms: FIBC despatch, bail packing list, jumbo bag shipment. Always TOP 50.

Table MIS_YarnDespatch. Domain: Despatch. Yarn/bobbin despatch (~219k) — CompanyName, InvNo, PartyName, BoxNo, Netwt, PackingListNo, Deneir, sysdate. Filter + TOP 50. Synonyms: yarn despatch, bobbin packing list. Always TOP 50.

Table SmallBagBailForDespatch. Domain: Despatch. Small-bag bail despatch (~266k) — CompanyName, PartyName, BailNo, PCS, Weight, InvNo, PACKINGLISTNO, SysDate. Filter + TOP 50. FIBC jumbo: FIBCDespatch. Synonyms: small bag despatch, smallbag packing. Always TOP 50.

View vw_RollforDespatch. Domain: Despatch. Rolls staged/available for despatch (~384k) — ROllNO, Quality, NetWt, Companyname (no Invno). Filter Companyname + TOP 50. Already shipped rolls with invoice: vw_MISrolldespatch. Synonyms: rolls for despatch, ready to despatch. Always TOP 50.

Table loginentry.dbo.LoginRights (also loginentry..loginrights). Domain: Users / login rights. Purpose: ERP user master — Name (username), FullName, Email, ContactNo, EmpCode, Category (Account/Purchase/Store/Marketing/Payroll/Finance/Production/Approval/HO), role flags IsAdmin IsFinance IsAccounts IsPayroll IsmaterialProc IsMarketing IsstoreHOD ispurchasehod isPaymentApprove ISAccounthOD. NEVER select Password. Cross-database query from MaterialProcessing. Joins: Name = PurchasePayment.LoginName for PO requester email; Name = BillPaymentEntry.Loginname; Name = ApprovePO.ApprovalName; Name = POAllocation.username. Synonyms: user email, login rights, who is username, employee contact, approver email, requester email, email id of user, jinal ka email, email kya hai, finance people emails. Example: SELECT TOP 50 Name, FullName, Email FROM loginentry.dbo.LoginRights WHERE Name = 'jinal'. Admin filter: IsAdmin = 'yes'. Prefer listed identity columns only — do not SELECT *.
